boundary_colour.note: Issue #942: every part boundary of the setup and every idle frame, against the rig's own parts.json pieces through rig-c's renderer. Clean public readings are 1 (demo, scarf), 3 (reference-sample) and 4 (wind, reference-demo); a texture stretched into its padded UVs or a 4x4 notch read 21 and up on demo and scarf. 12 is three times the largest clean reading and below the smallest plant.
